thread:
lina_cs: Heads up — Saffron onboarding just sent a DPA + SOC2 scope request. They specifically want: embeddings retention policy, KMS/BYOK options, and whether Private deployment is required for PHI. Legal wants answers by EOW. @ryan_cust can you coordinate?

ryan_cust: Got it. Looping in infra/eng. Do we have a one-pager or short FAQ to forward to their legal team?

sam_eng: We have the basics. Short answers: KMS integrs for Dedicated/Private (AWS/GCP/Azure KMS). BYOK available for Private deployments; Dedicated supports CMEK in some cloud regions — will confirm exact regions. Hosted API uses our managed keys by default.

marta_prod: I also have a SOC2 control mapping and DPA template in the onboarding drive. Will pull the relevant sections for their questions and paste here. Note: Saffron mentioned PHI — flagging as higher-touch.

devsec-bot: [policy-alert] saffron.health domain flagged for potential PHI intake. Recommend legal + compliance review before sharing any production screenshots or logs.

ryan_cust: Thanks. Lina — do we want to propose a 30m call (legal + infra) this week? They asked for clarifications and an implementation timeline by Friday.

lina_cs: Yes please. Offer Wed or Thu morning PT. Also ask them to share sample data flows so we can map controls.

sam_eng: I'll prepare a short checklist for the call and include these bullets:
- KMS/BYOK: Private = BYOK supported; Dedicated = CMEK in selected regions; Hosted = managed keys (can discuss SOC2 attestations).
- Embeddings retention: default 30 days for hosted embeddings cache; Dedicated/Private can set retention policy via config. Example config:
```
embeddings: { retention_days: 30 }
```
- PHI handling: recommend Private deployment or Dedicated with strict network controls + contractual safeguards.

marta_prod: Adding link to the doc + note about renewal risk — Saffron is evaluating 3 vendors and timeline is tight, so smooth answers help retention. https://redwood.internal/onboard/saffron (internal).

ryan_cust: I'll draft the email with the one-pager, propose Wed 10am PT, and add infra/legal to the invite. Posting updates here after the call prep.

lina_cs: Perfect. Quick items for follow-up: (1) Sam to confirm which regions support CMEK for Dedicated, (2) Marta to export the SOC2 mapping snippet, (3) Ryan to send calendar + draft reply.

sam_eng: On it — will post region list by EOD.

marta_prod: Will attach SOC2 mapping and DPA excerpts before the call.

ryan_cust: Invite sent for Wed 10am PT. Draft email below, please review before I send: "Hi Saffron team — thanks, attaching our SOC2 control mapping and short answers re: KMS, retention, and PHI recommendations. Can we align on a short call Wed 10am PT?"

lina_cs: Looks good, go ahead. :thumbsup:
